tests.name: colcon build of course_description; xacro expands vehicle.urdf.xacro; check_urdf parses the tree with root base_footprint
tree: one root, no cycles, no unknown links; expected parent and joint type of every link (sensors fixed on base_link)
geometry: camera, lidar and IMU at (0.28, 0, 0.38) in base_link by composing origins along the chain; camera_link_optical axes follow REP-103
chassis: wheelbase 0.8 m, track 0.62 m, wheel radius 0.12 m; wheels continuous about y, steering revolute about z within ±0.55 rad
SI units; inertia of body, wheels and sensors equals the homogeneous box/cylinder formula for their own geometry and is physically valid; separate visual and collision geometry
dimensions match the kit SDF course_ackermann: sensor and wheel positions, wheel_base, wheel_separation, wheel_radius, body size, masses
live: /tf_static of robot_state_publisher is RELIABLE + TRANSIENT_LOCAL; a late transient local subscriber gets the transforms (exit 0), a volatile one gets nothing (exit 124)
live: tf2_echo base_link lidar_link gives [0.280, 0.000, 0.380]; view_frames shows base_link -> lidar_link; /tf_static has one publisher
live: with /joint_states from zero_joint_states, /tf has one publisher robot_state_publisher (VOLATILE) and front_left_wheel is at [0.400, 0.310, 0.000]
model opens in RViz with Fixed Frame base_link, Global Status: Ok, wheels shown with zero_joint_states (screenshot evidence/pr06/rviz.png)

defect.reproducer: Branch pr06-defect, one commit (evidence/pr06/defect.patch): the lidar sensor macro gets parent="camera_link" instead of base_link with the same origin 0.28 0 0.38. check_urdf still parses the tree (lidar_link under camera_link), but ros2 run tf2_ros tf2_echo base_link lidar_link gives Translation [0.560, 0.000, 0.760], view_frames shows camera_link -> lidar_link, and test_expected_parent_and_joint_type[lidar_link], test_sensor_position_in_base_link[lidar_link] and test_dimensions_match_kit_sdf fail (evidence/pr06/frames.md, logs/model-check-defect.txt, logs/defect/).
defect.root_cause: A URDF joint origin is expressed in the parent frame. With camera_link as the parent, the lidar offset is added to the camera offset, so the lidar ends up at 0.28 + 0.28 and 0.38 + 0.38 from base_link. The tree stays connected and acyclic, so a structural check cannot see the error; only a geometric test of the expected parent and position can.
defect.proof_after: On main the lidar macro uses the default parent base_link: tf2_echo base_link lidar_link gives [0.280, 0.000, 0.380], view_frames shows base_link -> lidar_link, check_urdf passes, and the same tests that failed on pr06-defect pass together with the rest of course_description (evidence/pr06/model-check.txt, frames.md).
